notes.title: Great Big News!
notes.content: After one year, our game Survive Now is now completely free to play for all players. The game has returned enough to cover its Steam fees, so we are making it free! It is available on both Steam and the Play Store, and we have also added full controller support. Enjoy!

notes.title: Controller Support Added
notes.content:
Great news! We are excited to announce that controller support has been added to our action-packed roughlite 2D game. This means that you can now play the game using your favorite game controller, giving you even more control and precision in your gameplay.

To use your controller, simply plug it into your device and start playing the game. The game will automatically detect your controller and map the controls to the appropriate buttons and joysticks.

We hope that you enjoy this new feature and that it enhances your overall gaming experience. As always, we appreciate your feedback and suggestions.
Thank you for playing!
